subject: Demo recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp (success metrics, owners, timeline)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@lakeshore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp (success metrics, owners, timeline)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a concrete 4-week POC proposal to align on success criteria, responsibilities, and timeline. I attached a short one‑pager (POC-outline-lakeshore.pdf) and the minimal access spec (MAL_Access_Specs.xlsx).

Key objectives (what success looks like):
- 90th percentile inference latency <= 250ms for 512-token requests under the agreed load profile (see timeline).
- End-to-end task accuracy: retrieval+generation tests > 85% on the supplied labeled sample prompts (we'll help define the eval prompt set).
- Cost-per-1000 tokens within the projected band after batching/quantization recommendations.
- Stable telemetry: less than 1% error rate and observable traces for every failing call.

Proposed 4-week onramp (high level):
Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): data access, account & API keys, share sample dataset (2–5k docs), SOC2 questionnaire exchange.
Week 1 (ingest + baseline): ingest sample, baseline tests with out-of-the-box model, collect latency & quality baseline.
Week 2 (optimizations): enable batching/caching, try 8‑bit quantized variant, re-run evals; iterate prompts.
Week 3 (handoff + decision): confirm success metrics, run final acceptance tests, prepare handoff doc and next-step pricing.

Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood AE / program owner: Naomi Feldman (me) — commercial, schedule, acceptance.
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (cc) — onboarding, dataset requirements, test harness.
- Lakeshore technical lead: Alex Ramos — data access, security contact, test owners.

Immediate asks from Lakeshore to start:
1) Confirm the primary security contact who will receive the SOC2 questionnaire and VPN/connector instructions (we're expecting a security contact email).
2) Share the short sample dataset (2–5k docs) and a representative set of evaluation prompts.
3) Confirm target kickoff week (we suggested week of Oct 4).

If that all looks good I'll send a calendar for a 30-minute kickoff and loop in Ben for the technical onboarding.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.inference.com

Attachments: POC-outline-lakeshore.pdf (1 page), MAL_Access_Specs.xlsx (access fields)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@lakeshore.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@lakeshore.ai
Date: 2027-09-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp (success metrics, owners, timeline)

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. A few quick items from our side:

- Security owner: please forward the SOC2 questionnaire to secops@lakeshore.ai (I copied procurement above for timing).
- Dataset: we can provide a 3,200-document sample and a 120-utterance eval prompt set. I'll have someone drop the files to the shared Drive link you suggested by end of day Thursday.
- Timeline: Oct 4 week works but procurement may push the kickoff to Oct 11 depending on contract signing. Is Oct 11 acceptable as a fallback?
- Credits / cost: what does the hosted trial cost look like? We prefer trial credits + a short invoice for any overage. Can you send a reference for the expected credit util for the 4-week run?

Also: we need to validate data residency (we must keep sample docs in us-east region) and confirm there is no cross-region replication for the POC environment.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Ramos
Director, ML Platforms | Lakeshore Analytics
alex.ramos@lakeshore.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0214

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@lakeshore.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp (technical notes)

Thanks Alex — quick technical follow-ups from the runtime side so we can scope the onboarding: 

- Region: we can pin the POC to us-east-1 and disable cross-region replication for the trial environment; we'll send a short ATO note for lakeshore's records.
- Model & config suggestions: start with redwood-ggml-small (fp16) to get a quality baseline, then try quantized-8bit for cost testing in week 2.
- Sample data: please include a small set of labeled responses (50–100) and any privacy labels. Format: JSONL or CSV with a header column.
- Access: we'll need a technical contact with permission to create an S3-access role (or we can use secure upload path). We'll also supply an onboarding checklist — see onboarding-checklist.xlsx (attached).

If Alex confirms the sample and the region constraint, I can provision the sandbox and share API keys within 24–48 hours.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@lakeshore.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: secops@lakeshore.ai, procurement@lakeshore.ai
Date: 2027-09-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed 4-week POC onramp (confirming items)

Great — we'll do us-east-1 and we'll avoid cross-region replication. Procurement has started the DocuSign for the standard POC SOW (link below). SecOps will take the SOC2 questionnaire at secops@lakeshore.ai.

I asked our ML engineer, Priya Shah, to drop the sample bundle (3,200 docs + 120 eval prompts) to the Drive link you shared; she'll also add a short data schema doc. You should see the upload by Thursday EOD.

Procurement timeline: we expect DocuSign completed by Oct 6. If that holds, we can kickoff the week of Oct 11. I'll target an internal kickoff with SecOps and Procurement on Oct 6 to finalize the SOW.

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-LAKESHORE
Scope PDF attached: lakeshore-scope.pdf

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff on Oct 11 at 10:00 AM PT? If so, send the calendar invite and Ben, please include the preliminary sandbox provisioning steps in that invite so our ML engineer knows what to expect.

Thanks — Alex

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>

Date: 2027-09-24T09:12:00-07:00

Perfect — thanks Alex. Oct 11 10:00 AM PT is on my calendar. I've created a tentative invite and shared the drive doc link for the POC outline; calendar link below. Ben will include the sandbox provisioning checklist and the temporary API keys step in the invite description.

Next actions (I will own these and follow up):

- Ben: provision sandbox pinned to us-east-1 and prepare onboarding notes (before Oct 8).

If anything changes please flag it in the thread. Looking forward to getting this running.

Best —
Naomi Feldman
